“A caravan guard who can split a date at three hundred paces. She joined you because the Ashen Court stole her caravan, and she wants every camel back.”
“Captain of the Lantern Guard, sworn to protect the Jade Court. He paints a cherry blossom on his armour for every life he saves.”
“He learned shipbuilding as a common carpenter in foreign yards, then raised a capital from a frozen marsh. A ruler who will not learn, he says, cannot lead.”
“He made one nation out of thirty-nine quarrelling states, with patience first and iron second. He has already redrawn your maps.”
“He raised his lion, Zuri, from a cub. Together they have outrun wildfire, warbands and, once, an entire Ashen legion.”
“He slept beneath a hill in Britain, waiting for the hour of greatest need. He did not expect the hour to call from another world.”
“Last knight of the burned Valewood order. He carries his grandmother's blade and a promise: no village will burn while he still stands.”
“Master Sun wrote thirteen chapters that generals have studied ever since. The supreme art of war, he teaches, is to subdue the enemy without fighting.”
“Master of the great forges of Sunveldt. Her inventions are loud, brilliant and only occasionally on fire.”
“Nobody knows her real name. The Sultanate's enemies know only her twin daggers, and the silence they leave behind.”
“Painter when they pay him, engineer when they listen. He has spent his life asking how birds fly and why water curls, and Aeloria has given him new questions.”
“Raised by the oldest oak in Greenhold, Elowen speaks to roots and rain. She is gentle with everyone except those who set forests on fire.”
“Rodrigo Díaz of Vivar, exiled by his own king, kept his word to him anyway. Friend and foe alike called him El Cid, the Lord.”
“She has read the ice for seventy winters and remembers every name the Hollow King has stolen. The runes on her staff hum when ash is near.”
“She steers by stars and swells and has never lost a ship. When she sings, the sea itself seems to listen.”
“Sovereign of the Amber Sultanate, who rides the wind with a thousand falcons. She once wore a shard of the Sunspire Crown, and she wants it back.”
“The blue-eyed seer of Yamama saw an army three days away, hidden behind branches. Her people laughed that trees do not walk. She will not be doubted twice.”
“The strongest man on any island, and the gentlest. His tattoos tell the story of every storm he has stood against.”
“The youngest Grand Sage in the Dominion's history. With one folded fan she can turn a typhoon, or an argument.”
“Warrior and poet of the sands of Najd. They would not call him free until his sword spoke for him; after that, they could call him nothing else.”
“Youngest jarl-daughter of Frostmark, who held the Hrim Pass for nine days with forty shields. She does not retreat; she advances in a different direction.”
